products.title: Musk Rijal | Alcohol-Free Attar Roll-On
products.body_html:
Musk Rijal: a bold, classic musk with timeless character.

Musk Rijal opens with deep, smooth musk, settles into a warm oriental heart, and finishes on a rich woody base. Refined, elegant and long-lasting, it is a unisex attar loved by men and women alike.

Fragrance notes: Musky · Oriental · Woody

Why you'll love it

  • 100% alcohol-free, a pure attar that's gentle on skin
  • Long-lasting fragrance that stays with you through the day
  • Easy roll-on applicator, with no spills and no mess
  • Elegant gold bottle with traditional engraved design
  • Comes in a premium box, a perfect gift for Eid, weddings and special occasions

How to use: Roll gently on your wrists and apply on your shirt. A little goes a long way.
